title: Kinesift run request

seed.description: The runtime requires an integer JSON literal without decimal point or exponent; boolean values are rejected. A JSON Schema validator may treat numerically integral decimals as integers, so also enforce this lexical restriction.

description: One UTF-8 JSON object, at most 65536 bytes. Duplicate keys and non-finite numbers are rejected before schema validation. Omit actions to observe; an empty array evaluates a no-op attempt.
